welcome: Welcome. Explore what is nearby, see today's offers and ask the front desk for anything you need.

sections.title: Dining
sections.intro: Breakfast, lunch and dinner, all in walking distance.

cards.title: Lobby cafe
cards.detail: Coffee, pastries and light meals on the ground floor. Ask the desk for a table.

cards.title: Rooftop grill
cards.detail: Seasonal menu with city views. Reservations recommended on weekends.

cards.title: In-room dining
cards.detail: Order from the room phone or the app. Breakfast is served until 11am.

cards.title: Pool deck
cards.detail: Pool deck on level 2. Towels are at the spa desk.

cards.title: Spa
cards.detail: Massage and facial treatments. Ask the concierge about first-visit offers.

cards.title: Airport shuttle
cards.detail: Pick-up at the front entrance. Ask the front desk for the schedule.

cards.title: Taxi and rideshare
cards.detail: The front desk can call a taxi any time of day.

cards.title: Sample Coffee Co.
cards.detail: Show this screen at the coffee bar. Sample offer for demonstration.

cards.title: Demo Auto Group
cards.detail: Book a service visit at the front desk. Sample offer for demonstration.

cards.title: Sample Spa & Wellness
cards.detail: Ask the concierge. Sample offer for demonstration.
